name: 32571 · Pace, FL
findings: ZIP 32571 (Pace) has 80 nonprofit organizations. 31 of them (39%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 22 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 32571 (Pace) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 32571 (Pace) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 56% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 30% of all organizations here have no identified type.
